name: BRAC household rehydration education
description: BRAC fieldworkers taught household rehydration knowledge to mothers across Bangladesh between 1980 and 1990.

impact.note: Teaching mothers nationwide put an existing therapy into homes across one society and became a model for later community health programmes.

date.basis: Date applies to the scoped observation or event; it is not a claim of global origin.

events.statement: BRAC fieldworkers taught household rehydration knowledge to mothers across Bangladesh between 1980 and 1990.

evidence.supports: The report describes BRAC fieldworkers providing household rehydration education to more than 12 million mothers between 1980 and 1990. This reported reach is not a count of treatments, a denominator-based coverage rate, or proof of a mortality effect.

events.caveats: The reported cumulative teaching reach does not measure use, equitable coverage or mortality reduction.
